resources.string: Smart voice assistant for your smart plugs. Say “Wiki”, then your command.
If enabling the accessibility service is greyed out: open App info → ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”, then come back and enable it.
Tap “Scan”: the app opens the plug app and reads the names of all your plugs, then you confirm them. You can also add names by hand.

The built-in smart engine is always ready, even offline: it understands Arabic and English, plug names (even when pronounced imperfectly), “all plugs”, timers (in 10 minutes) and plug status.
With a key, a Claude model takes over: it understands free speech, remembers the last turns and answers any question.
Examples: “Wiki turn on the kitchen plug” • “Wiki turn off all plugs” • “Wiki turn off the washer in 10 minutes” • “Wiki is the iron on?”. Timers work as long as listening is running.
Enable the Wikismart accessibility service first
Lets Wikismart open your smart plug app, read the device names and press the on/off control based on your voice commands.
